human.bridge.candidate-ancestry: Derived from cycle.candidate.artifactRef only when no existing-capability ancestry is present.
human.bridge.reuse-existing-ancestry: Derived from cycle.gap.existingCapabilityRef only for exact NO_GAP / REUSE_EXISTING cycles with no candidate.
human.bridge.intervention-link-native-ve: Digest-bound v2 link rebuilds from the exact verified cycle and protocol.
human.bridge.every-current-chain: Exact current portfolio coverage must remain four of four routes.

human.bridge.live-only: Synthetic and forged-LIVE fixtures map to UNKNOWN.
human.bridge.scope-bind: Protocol, judgment, binding, claim, and capability scope must agree.
human.bridge.source-trust-bind: Named steward and cohort trust modes require their exact external reference schemas; the bridge does not authenticate identity.
human.bridge.closure-bind: Current closure must cover the cycle, protocol, evaluation, judgment, link, comparison surfaces, baseline, capability surface, and trust reference.
human.bridge.synthetic-hold: Synthetic fixtures remain contract evidence and cannot become human benefit.

human.bridge.v1-preserved: v2 is a separate leaf; no v1 source, schema, contract, or prior sealed receipt is rewritten.

authority.human-steward.preserve: No human input, execution, install, permission, promotion, merge, CANON, or Foundation authority.

growth.human-evidence.live: No person opted in; no LIVE session, evaluation, explicit judgment, bridge bundle, or Grounded Growth refresh exists.
